evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: SAGE coordinates specialized agents for task-aware planning, tool-mediated evidence acquisition, claim-level verification, and bounded replanning under a constrained shared-state runtime.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Remarkably, SAGE with Qwen3.5-9B surpasses much larger monolithic LVLMs on most evaluated metrics, highlighting the importance of structured, evidence-grounded inference beyond model scaling.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
